name: deere-shop-seo-worker
description: SEO content-factory worker for Deere-Shop. Control-plane only: creates draft seo_work_items and article drafts. Disabled/shadow by default. Draft-only. No publish method.

scripts.check: node -e "const{readdirSync}=require('node:fs');const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');let failed=0;for(const dir of ['src','scripts'])for(const f of readdirSync(dir))if(f.endsWith('.mjs')){try{execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',dir+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'})}catch{failed=1}}process.exit(failed)"
